This uniform percentage shall be equal to the percentage difference between the originally quo ted “Total Price” and the “Total Matched Price” expressed with reference to the originally quoted “Total Price”. 19.0 Comprehensive guidelines regarding implementation of GeM Incident Management (IM) Policy in procurement of Services through GeM Portal 1.0 Banning of business dealing by NPCIL/Buyer NPCIL reserves the right to initiate Banning as per NPCIL’s Banning of business dealings as mentioned below and are independent of action under GeM’s IM (Incident Management) Policy. Malafide / unlawful acts / malpractices or improper conduct on part of contractor based on the a pproved findings of the Investigation Agency. 1.1.5. Withdrawal of a bid or refusal to accept an award of contract with the NPCIL without justifiable c ause, after being adjudged as the successful bidder. 1.1.9. Supply of Counterfeit items Breach of Code of Integrity. 1.1.10. Bidder shall not act in contravention of the codes which includes 1.1.10.1 Prohibition of a.
